title: fever trend
task: Skin-temperature patch: 6 readings over 3 h -> normal / rising trend / fever.
signal: 6 samples one per 30 min (4-bit, 0.25 C per unit above 36.0 C); normal is flat at 36.4-37.2 C, a rising trend climbs 0.24-0.44 C per hour from 36.5-37.0 C, fever sits at 38.0-39.5 C; 0.12 C noise.
model_size: 6 rounds x depth 3 (18 trees), 3 classes, TreeLUT w_feature=4, w_tree=3; input 6 x 4-bit
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
